average_union_argument: For m query supports on 112 ports with incidence at most I, the mean union of a random k-subset is at most 112 minus ((112-r)*C(m-t,k)+r*C(m-t-1,k))/C(m,k), where I=112*t+r. The coverage function is concave in port multiplicity. Every k-subset intersects the rank-eight code in dimension at least k+8-N.
remaining_obligations: The nine-rank-seven simplex case and the rank-one/rank-six/eight-rank-seven case need their separate exact geometric proofs. This script does not prove those closures.
scope: Fixed current E8 code and SOURCE encoding, independent scalar query rows, private frame cost. This is a necessary profile screen, not a circuit or kappa improvement.
